nodes.description: Mapping address => uint256 reflection balances (_rOwned)
Mapping address => address => uint256 ERC20 allowances (_allowances)
Mapping address => bool fee/max-tx exclusion (_isExcludedFromFee)
Total reflections _rTotal, decreased by _reflectFee
Accumulated token fees _tFeeTotal
Burn/team fee percentage _burnFee, initialised to 1
Tax fee percentage _taxFee, initialised to INITIAL_TAX
payable receiver of ETH taxes _taxWallet, set to deployer in constructor
Max buy amount _maxTxAmount, 5% of supply, removable via removeBuyLimit
IUniswapV2Router02 router instance _uniswap
Liquidity pair address _pair created in startTrading
Trading enabled flag _canTrade
Reentrancy guard flag _inSwap used by lockTheSwap modifier
Automatic swap-to-ETH toggle _swapEnabled
Ownable owner address _owner, assigned from msg.sender in constructor
private _transfer(from,to,amount): gates max-tx via unverified external O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount, triggers swap and ETH payout before token state updates
private swapTokensForEth: approves router and performs swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens, internal swap path
external onlyTaxCollector startTrading: creates pair and adds liquidity
external onlyTaxCollector removeBuyLimit: sets _maxTxAmount to full supply
external onlyTaxCollector lowerTax: reduces _taxFee below INITIAL_TAX
private sendETHToFee: transfers ETH to _taxWallet
external onlyTaxCollector manualSwap: swaps contract token balance for ETH
external onlyTaxCollector manualSend: sends entire ETH balance to tax wallet
private _transferStandard: updates _rOwned, takes team fee and reflects fee, emits Transfer
private _approve: writes _allowances after zero-address checks
public transfer: calls _transfer with msg.sender as from
public transferFrom: calls _transfer then decrements allowance
public view balanceOf: converts reflected balance via tokenFromReflection
private view tokenFromReflection: requires rAmount <= _rTotal and divides by current rate
external onlyTaxCollector endTrading: disables swapping and trading flags
private _takeTeam: credits team fee reflections to the contract
private _reflectFee: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal
private view _getValues: computes r/t amount/fee/team values
private pure _getTValues: percentage fee arithmetic on tAmount
private pure _getRValues: reflection arithmetic using currentRate
private view _getRate: rSupply / tSupply division
private view _getCurrentSupply: returns reflected and total supply
constructor: sets _taxWallet to msg.sender, seeds _rOwned and fee exclusions
msg.sender: caller identity used for ownership, tax wallet and every transfer entry point
block.timestamp: used as router swap and liquidity deadline
External call O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount(address(this)) to an unverified contract that gates every transfer
External call _uniswap.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens executed inside the transfer path
_taxWallet.transfer(amount) ETH payout to the tax wallet address
External call _uniswap.addLiquidityETH{value: address(this).balance} inside startTrading
External call IUniswapV2Factory(_uniswap.factory()).createPair in startTrading
Fee/reflection arithmetic (tAmount.mul(taxFee).div(100), tAmount.mul(currentRate), supply division) affecting balances and supply
amount argument of transfer/transferFrom
recipient argument of transfer
sender argument of transferFrom
from argument of private _transfer
to argument of private _transfer
tAmount argument of _transferStandard/_getValues
newTaxRate argument of lowerTax
account argument of balanceOf
tokenAmount argument of swapTokensForEth
amount argument of sendETHToFee
spender argument of approve/_approve
contractTokenBalance computed in _transfer
contractETHBalance compared against TAX_THRESHOLD in _transfer
swap path array [token, WETH] in swapTokensForEth
currentRate derived from _getRate() in _takeTeam/tokenFromReflection/_getValues
tTransferAmount, tFee, tTeam computed in _getTValues
rAmount, rTransferAmount, rFee computed in _getRValues
msgSender local assigned from _msgSender() in constructor

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the from address of transfer()
msg.sender is used as spender and allowance owner in transferFrom()
constructor assigns _owner from msg.sender, granting owner privileges
constructor assigns _taxWallet = payable(msg.sender), making the deployer the ETH tax receiver
onlyTaxCollector compares _taxWallet with msg.sender before removeBuyLimit executes
onlyTaxCollector compares _taxWallet with msg.sender before lowerTax changes the tax rate
onlyTaxCollector gates manualSwap using msg.sender
onlyTaxCollector gates manualSend using msg.sender
onlyTaxCollector gates startTrading and the liquidity/pair setup using msg.sender
onlyTaxCollector gates endTrading, letting the tax collector freeze swapping
caller identity reaches _transfer as the from parameter through transfer/transferFrom
block.timestamp is used as the router swap deadline, making the swap miner-influenced
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline in startTrading
_transfer requires O(ROUTER_ADDRESS).amount(address(this)); an unverified external contract can gate or DoS every transfer
_transfer calls swapTokensForEth when the contract token balance is swapped automatically
_transfer delegates the balance mutation to _transferStandard
_transfer sends ETH to the fee wallet when contractETHBalance exceeds TAX_THRESHOLD
external router swap executes in the transfer path before _rOwned state updates and is only guarded by the _inSwap flag
swapTokensForEth approves the router via _approve before swapping
swapTokensForEth calls _uniswap.WETH() to build the swap path
_transferStandard calls _takeTeam for the team/team fee portion
_transferStandard calls _reflectFee to burn reflections and accumulate fees
_transferStandard obtains amounts from _getValues
_transferStandard subtracts from and adds to _rOwned balances
_approve writes the _allowances allowance entry
_getValues calls _getTValues for token fee amounts
_getValues calls _getRValues for reflection amounts
_getValues obtains currentRate from _getRate
_getRate divides rSupply by tSupply obtained from _getCurrentSupply
percentage fee math tAmount.mul(taxFee).div(100) and tAmount.sub(tFee).sub(tTeam) determine transferred amounts
reflection math rAmount = tAmount.mul(currentRate) and rAmount.sub(rFee).sub(rTeam) underpins balances
_reflectFee decreases _rTotal by rFee
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee
_takeTeam credits rTeam to _rOwned[address(this)]
balanceOf converts _rOwned[account] through tokenFromReflection
tokenFromReflection requires rAmount <= _rTotal and divides by the rate
transfer() invokes the internal _transfer entry point
transferFrom() invokes the internal _transfer entry point
transferFrom() decrements allowance via _approve
sendETHToFee forwards ETH to the tax wallet with a raw transfer
sendETHToFee pays the _taxWallet state variable
manualSwap invokes swapTokensForEth on the full contract balance
manualSend forwards the whole ETH balance through sendETHToFee
startTrading reads router factory/WETH and approves the router through _uniswap
startTrading calls _uniswap.addLiquidityETH with the full ETH balance
startTrading creates the pair through the factory call
startTrading stores the created pair in _pair and approves it
startTrading sets _canTrade to true
removeBuyLimit raises _maxTxAmount to the full total supply
lowerTax writes the new _taxFee value
_maxTxAmount restricts qualifying buys inside _transfer
_isExcludedFromFee lets whitelisted addresses bypass max-transaction checks
_inSwap is the sole reentrancy guard consulted by _transfer before the external swap
_swapEnabled decides whether _transfer performs the automatic swap
_transfer compares from/to against _pair and address(_uniswap)
_burnFee is passed as TeamFee into _getTValues
_taxFee is passed as taxFee into _getTValues
balanceOf reads the _rOwned mapping for the requested account

normalization_plan.reason: ERC20 amount argument flows directly into the private _transfer as the transferred value
transfer recipient is forwarded to _transfer as the to parameter
transferFrom sender is the spender-supplied source address consumed by the function
_transfer from parameter is the origin address of the internal transfer
_transfer to parameter is the destination address of the internal transfer
tAmount is the value processed by _transferStandard for balance mutation
newTaxRate is the only input consumed by lowerTax
account is the lookup key used by balanceOf
tokenAmount is the swap input consumed by swapTokensForEth
amount is the ETH value forwarded by sendETHToFee to the tax wallet
contractTokenBalance is a transient computed inside _transfer feeding the swap call
contractETHBalance only exists to decide whether sendETHToFee is invoked
path is the ephemeral swap route array built inside swapTokensForEth
currentRate is the value returned by _getRate and reused for conversions
tTransferAmount/tFee/tTeam are the return tuple of _getTValues
rAmount/rTransferAmount/rFee are the return tuple of _getRValues
msgSender local is only the constructor's captured caller identity
